```{r}
################################################################################ 
# 1. Compare average occupancy of species (MAWR and SWSP) 
################################################################################ 
# Function to read and label data
read_occ_data <- function(path, source_label, pattern) {
  files <- list.files(path, pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  bind_rows(lapply(files, function(file) {
    dat <- read_csv(file)
    species <- str_extract(basename(file), "^[^_]+")  # Extract species from filename
    dat %>%
      mutate(Species = species,
             Source = source_label)
  }))
}

# Read in ARU and PC datasets
aru_data <- read_occ_data(aru_AnnualOcc_filepath, "ARU", "_occ_thru24.csv")
pc_data  <- read_occ_data(pc_AnnualOcc_filepath, "PC", "_occ_thru24.csv")


# Combine and prepare
combined <- bind_rows(aru_data, pc_data) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Species %in% c("MAWR", "SWSP", "SORA")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("MAWR", "SWSP", "SORA"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Source, year, means, stanerror, lowerci, upperci)

mocc_data <- combined %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Source, values_from = means) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ARU, PC), names_to = "Source", values_to = "means") %>%
  drop_na(means)

mocc_data$year <- factor(mocc_data$year)  # Ensure year is treated as categorical

mocc_species_comp_fl <- ggplot(
  mocc_data,
  aes(x = as.numeric(as.character(year)), y = means, color = Source, group = Source)
) +

  # CI bars
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(0, lowerci),
      ymax = pmin(1, upperci)
    ),
    width = 0,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # trend lines
  geom_line(linetype = 2, size = 1.2) +

  # points
  geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 21, stroke = 1.2, fill = "white") +
  #geom_point(
  #  aes(fill = Source),   # fill instead of color
  #  color = "black",      # outline
  #  size = 2.5,
  #  shape = 21,
  #  stroke = 1.2
  #) +
  
  # facet layout: species rows, method columns
  facet_grid(
    Species ~ Source,
    labeller = labeller(
      Species = c(
        "MAWR" = "Marsh Wren",
        "SWSP" = "Swamp Sparrow",
        "SORA" = "Sora"
      )
  ),
  switch = "y"
  ) +

  # colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("ARU" = "#F8766D", "PC" = "#00BFC4"),
    name = "Survey Type"
  ) +
    
  # axes
  #scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    position = "right"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.position = "left"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = as.numeric(as.character(unique(mocc_data$year)))
) +

  labs(
    title = "Occupancy Trends ± CI by Species and Survey Type",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Occupancy probability"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.placement = "outside",
      strip.position = "left",
      legend.position = "top",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
mocc_species_comp_fl

# Save plot
ggsave("D:/Documents/Audubon/AGL/ARU/Occupancy/Results_Figs_Comparison/mocc_species_comp_fl_classic.png", plot = mocc_species_comp_fl,
       width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300, units = "in")

################################################################################  
# Compare average occupancy of species by Route
################################################################################ 

# Read in ARU and PC datasets
aru_data_r <- read_occ_data(aru_SiteOcc_filepath, "ARU", "_occ_output_2024.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Route, mocc, mean_se, Species, Source)
pc_data_r  <- read_occ_data(pc_SiteOcc_filepath, "PC", "_occ_output_2024.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Route, mocc, mean_se, Species, Source)

species_list <- c("MAWR", "SWSP", "SORA")

# Combine and prepare
mocc_data_r <- bind_rows(aru_data_r, pc_data_r) %>%
  filter(Species %in% species_list) 

species_occ_comp <- function(species_code, species_name, data) {
  data <- data %>%
    filter(Species == species_code)
  
  data$Route <- as.factor(data$Route)
  data$Year <- as.factor(data$Year)
  
  mocc_comp <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Year, y = mocc, color = Source, group = Source)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(0, mocc - mean_se),
      ymax = pmin(1, mocc + mean_se)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Route, ncol = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("ARU" = "#F8766D", "PC" = "#00BFC4"),
    name = "Survey Type"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Mean", species_name, " Occupancy ± SE by Route, Year, and Survey Type"),
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Occupancy"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_grey(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
  
}

# Run function on species with occupancy data for both ARUs and PCs
```

```{r}
library(unmarked)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# File paths
#------------------------------------------------------------

aru_model_dir <- "D:/Documents/Audubon/AGL/ARU/Occupancy/Results_OC_ModelFiles"
pc_model_dir  <- "D:/Documents/Audubon/AGL/ARU/Occupancy/Results_OC_ModelFiles_PC"

aru_cov_path <- "D:/Documents/Audubon/AGL/ARU/Occupancy/Results_Covariates_ARU/ARU_covariates.rds"
pc_cov_path  <- "D:/Documents/Audubon/AGL/ARU/Occupancy/Results_Covariates_PC/PC_covariates.rds"

out_dir <- "D:/Documents/Audubon/AGL/ARU/Occupancy/Results_Figs_Comparison"

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Species to compare
#------------------------------------------------------------

species_tbl <- tibble(
  species_code = c("MAWR", "SWSP", "SORA"),
  species_name = c("Marsh Wren", "Swamp Sparrow", "Sora")
)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: load .Rda model object
#------------------------------------------------------------

load_rda_object <- function(path) {
  e <- new.env()
  nm <- load(path, envir = e)
  e[[nm[1]]]
}

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: load species-specific UMFs and models
#------------------------------------------------------------

load_species_data <- function(species_code) {
  
  ARU_covs <- readRDS(aru_cov_path)
  PC_covs  <- readRDS(pc_cov_path)
  
  aru_umf <- readRDS(file.path(aru_model_dir, paste0(species_code, ".umf.rds")))
  pc_umf  <- readRDS(file.path(pc_model_dir,  paste0(species_code, ".umf.rds")))
  
  aru_model <- load_rda_object(
    file.path(aru_model_dir, paste0(species_code, "_occ_OC.Rda"))
  )
  
  pc_model <- load_rda_object(
    file.path(pc_model_dir, paste0(species_code, "_occ_OC.Rda"))
  )
  
  list(
    aru_umf = aru_umf,
    pc_umf = pc_umf,
    aru_model = aru_model,
    pc_model = pc_model,
    dates_aru = ARU_covs$dates_aru,
    times_aru = ARU_covs$times_aru,   # ARU species-specific list
    dates_pc  = PC_covs$dates_pc,
    times_pc  = PC_covs$times_pc      # PC shared matrix
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
#------------------------------------------------------------

det_terms <- function(model) {
  all.vars(model@formula[[2]])
}

has_quadratic <- function(term, terms_vec) {
  paste0("I(", term, "^2)") %in% terms_vec
}

get_scale_param <- function(umf, dates_orig = NULL, times_orig = NULL) {
  
  date_mean <- attr(umf, "date_mean")
  date_sd   <- attr(umf, "date_sd")
  time_mean <- attr(umf, "time_mean")
  time_sd   <- attr(umf, "time_sd")
  
  if (is.null(date_mean)) date_mean <- mean(dates_orig, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.null(date_sd))   date_sd   <- sd(dates_orig, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.null(time_mean)) time_mean <- mean(times_orig, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.null(time_sd))   time_sd   <- sd(times_orig, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  list(
    date_mean = date_mean,
    date_sd = date_sd,
    time_mean = time_mean,
    time_sd = time_sd
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: build prediction data
#------------------------------------------------------------

build_det_pred <- function(
  umf,
  model,
  source_label,
  dates_orig = NULL,
  times_orig = NULL,
  covariate = c("date", "time"),
  n = 100,
  origin_date = "2024-01-01"
) {
  
  covariate <- match.arg(covariate)
  terms_vec <- det_terms(model)
  
  # Skip if selected model does not include focal covariate
  if (!covariate %in% terms_vec) return(NULL)
  
  scales <- get_scale_param(
  umf = umf,
  dates_orig = dates_orig,
  times_orig = times_orig
)

  date_mean <- scales$date_mean
  date_sd   <- scales$date_sd
  time_mean <- scales$time_mean
  time_sd   <- scales$time_sd
  
  focal_scaled <- seq(
    min(umf@obsCovs[[covariate]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(umf@obsCovs[[covariate]], na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = n
  )
  
  new_data <- data.frame(x = seq_along(focal_scaled))[, FALSE]
  new_data[[covariate]] <- focal_scaled
  
  if (has_quadratic(covariate, terms_vec)) {
    new_data[[paste0("I(", covariate, "^2)")]] <- focal_scaled^2
  }
  
  if (covariate == "date") {
    
    x_real <- focal_scaled * date_sd + date_mean
    
    if ("time" %in% terms_vec) {
      fixed_time <- median(umf@obsCovs$time, na.rm = TRUE)
      new_data$time <- fixed_time
      
      if (has_quadratic("time", terms_vec)) {
        new_data[["I(time^2)"]] <- fixed_time^2
      }
    }
    
  } else {
    
    x_real <- focal_scaled * time_sd + time_mean
    
    if ("date" %in% terms_vec) {
      fixed_date <- median(umf@obsCovs$date, na.rm = TRUE)
      new_data$date <- fixed_date
      
      if (has_quadratic("date", terms_vec)) {
        new_data[["I(date^2)"]] <- fixed_date^2
      }
    }
  }
  
  pred <- predict(model, type = "det", newdata = new_data)
  
  pred %>%
    mutate(
      x = x_real,
      source = source_label,
      covariate = covariate
    )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: Summarize Models
#------------------------------------------------------------
summarize_det_model <- function(model, species_name, source_label) {
  
  # Detection formula terms
  terms_vec <- all.vars(model@formula[[2]])
  formula_txt <- deparse(model@formula[[2]])
  
  # Detection coefficients
  coefs <- coef(model, type = "det")
  coef_names <- names(coefs)
  
  date_coef_name <- grep("date", coef_names, value = TRUE)
  time_coef_name <- grep("time", coef_names, value = TRUE)
  
  date_linear_name <- grep("date", date_coef_name, value = TRUE)[1]
  time_linear_name <- grep("time", time_coef_name, value = TRUE)[1]
  
  has_date <- "date" %in% terms_vec
  has_time <- "time" %in% terms_vec
  
  has_date_quad <- grepl("I\\(date\\^2\\)", formula_txt)
  has_time_quad <- grepl("I\\(time\\^2\\)", formula_txt)
  
  date_beta <- if (has_date && length(date_linear_name) > 0) coefs[date_linear_name] else NA_real_
  time_beta <- if (has_time && length(time_linear_name) > 0) coefs[time_linear_name] else NA_real_
  
  tibble(
    species = species_name,
    source = source_label,
    det_formula = formula_txt,
    has_date = has_date,
    has_date_quad = has_date_quad,
    has_time = has_time,
    has_time_quad = has_time_quad,
    date_beta = date_beta,
    time_beta = time_beta,
    
    date_effect = case_when(
      !has_date ~ "not included",
      has_date_quad ~ "quadratic / unimodal",
      date_beta > 0 ~ "monotonic increasing",
      date_beta < 0 ~ "monotonic decreasing",
      TRUE ~ "unclear"
    ),
    
    time_effect = case_when(
      !has_time ~ "not included",
      has_time_quad ~ "quadratic / unimodal",
      time_beta > 0 ~ "monotonic increasing",
      time_beta < 0 ~ "monotonic decreasing",
      TRUE ~ "unclear"
    )
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Build all predictions
#------------------------------------------------------------

all_preds <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(species_tbl))) {
  
  sp_code <- species_tbl$species_code[i]
  sp_name <- species_tbl$species_name[i]
  
  dat <- load_species_data(sp_code)
  
  for (cov in c("date", "time")) {
    
    pred_aru <- build_det_pred(
    umf = dat$aru_umf,
    model = dat$aru_model,
    source_label = "ARU",
    dates_orig = dat$dates_aru,
    times_orig = dat$times_aru[[sp_code]],
    covariate = cov
  )
  
  pred_pc <- build_det_pred(
    umf = dat$pc_umf,
    model = dat$pc_model,
    source_label = "PC",
    dates_orig = dat$dates_pc,
    times_orig = dat$times_pc,
    covariate = cov
  )
    
    preds <- bind_rows(pred_aru, pred_pc)
    
    if (nrow(preds) > 0) {
      preds <- preds %>%
        mutate(
          species = sp_name,
          species_code = sp_code
        )
      
      all_preds[[length(all_preds) + 1]] <- preds
    }
  }
}

plot_df <- bind_rows(all_preds)


#------------------------------------------------------------
# Reorder species and restrict to central 95% observed ranges
#------------------------------------------------------------

species_order <- c("Marsh Wren", "Swamp Sparrow", "Sora")

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    species = factor(species, levels = species_order)
  )

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot: ARU and PC detection probabilities
#------------------------------------------------------------

detprob_comp_all <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = x, y = Predicted, color = source)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = source),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = NA
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    species ~ covariate,
    scales = "free_x",
    switch = "y",
    labeller = labeller(
      covariate = c(
        date = "Date",
        time = "Time"
      )
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Survey Method",
    values = c("ARU" = "#F8766D", "PC" = "#00BFC4")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Survey Method",
    values = c("ARU" = "#F8766D", "PC" = "#00BFC4")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = function(x) pretty(x, n = 6),
    labels = function(x) {
      if (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 50) {
        format(as.Date(x - 1, origin = "2024-01-01"), "%b %d")
      } else {
        h <- floor(x)
        m <- round((x - h) * 60)
        sprintf("%02d:%02d", h, m)
      }
    }
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
  position = "right",
  limits = c(0, 1)
) +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Detection probability",
    title = "Detection Probability by Date or Time and Survey Method"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none",
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA))
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.position = "left",
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

detprob_comp_all

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "detprob_comp_all.png"),
  plot = detprob_comp_all,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in"
)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot: ARU and PC detection probabilities
#------------------------------------------------------------
model_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(species_tbl)), function(i) {
  
  sp_code <- species_tbl$species_code[i]
  sp_name <- species_tbl$species_name[i]
  
  dat <- load_species_data(sp_code)
  
  bind_rows(
    summarize_det_model(dat$aru_model, sp_name, "ARU"),
    summarize_det_model(dat$pc_model,  sp_name, "PC")
  )
})

model_summary
```
